map.算例：高 6m、距 5m 的面光: Worked example: front light at 6 m height, 5 m distance
map.灯具高度 6m、水平距离 5m：投射角 = arctan(6/5) ≈ 50.2: Fixture height 6 m, horizontal distance 5 m: throw angle = arctan(6/5) ≈ 50.2°, depression angle ≈ 39.8°, slant distance ≈ 7.81 m, height/distance ratio 1.20, i.e. front light (40–50°). Then with a throw angle of 45°, height 6 m and beam angle 25°: horizontal mounting distance = 6 / tan45° = 6.00 m, slant distance ≈ 8.49 m, spot radius ≈ 1.88 m, diameter ≈ 3.76 m, illuminated area ≈ 11.12 m².
map.投射角越大越好吗？: Is a larger throw angle always better?
map.不是。角度过大趋近顶光/逆光，会减少面部亮度、加重阴影；面光以 40–50° 为: No. Too large an angle approaches top or back light, reducing facial brightness and deepening shadows; front light works best at 40–50° and side light at 45–60°, combined according to the shaping goal.
map.高度和距离哪个对光斑大小影响更大？: Which affects spot size more, height or distance?

map.投射角度(弧度) = atan2(灯高, 水平距离)，再乘 180 ÷ π 转为: Projection angle (radians) = atan2(lamp height, horizontal distance), then multiplied by 180 ÷ π to get degrees; depression angle (measured from vertical) = 90 − projection angle; oblique throw distance = √(lamp height² + horizontal distance²); height-to-distance ratio = lamp height ÷ horizontal distance. Position verdict: 40°–50° front light, 30°–40° side-front light, 50°–60° side light, > 60° top/back light, < 30° low-angle footlight; when lamp height or horizontal distance is ≤ 0, prompt that it must be greater than 0

map.投射角度(弧度) = atan2(灯高, 水平距离)，再乘 180 ÷ π 转为: Projection angle (rad) = atan2(height, horizontal distance), then × 180 ÷ π; depression from vertical = 90 − projection angle; slant distance = √(height² + horizontal distance²); height/distance ratio = height ÷ horizontal distance. Only the vertical projection angle, depression, slant distance and ratio are output; angle alone cannot classify front/side/back light (horizontal orientation is also required). 40–50° is only a common front-light vertical-angle reference; prompt when height or distance ≤ 0.
map.输入灯具投射距离与安装高度，计算投光角度与水平偏移量，用于舞台、场馆布灯定位与光: Enter throw distance and mounting height to compute projection angle and horizontal offset for stage and venue fixture positioning and spot coverage planning. Front light commonly uses a 40–50° vertical projection angle and must be located directly in front of the stage; derive the mounting angle from trim height and horizontal distance.
map.垂直投射角 = arctan(高度 / 水平距离)，只由高度与水平距离决定。40: Vertical projection angle = arctan(height / horizontal distance), determined only by height and horizontal distance. 40–50° is a common front-light vertical-angle reference, but front light also requires the fixture directly in front of the stage; 30–60° may suit front-side or side light depending on horizontal orientation. Never name a position from angle alone.
map.区分垂直光轴圆截面与舞台水平椭圆投影的长短轴和面积。: Distinguish the circular cross-section perpendicular to the beam axis from the stage-floor elliptical projection, including major/minor axes and area.
map.灯具高度 6m、水平距离 5m：投射角 = arctan(6/5) ≈ 50.2: Height 6m, horizontal distance 5m: projection angle = arctan(6/5) ≈ 50.2°, depression ≈ 39.8°, slant distance ≈ 7.81 m, height/distance ratio 1.20—a front-light range (40–50°). With projection angle 45°, height 6m, beam angle 25°: horizontal mounting distance = 6 / tan45° = 6.00 m, slant distance ≈ 8.49 m; perpendicular cross-section radius ≈ 1.88 m, area ≈ 11.12 m²; stage-floor ellipse minor axis ≈ 3.76 m, major axis ≈ 5.32 m, area ≈ 15.72 m². If the projection angle drops to 10° (below the 12.5° half-beam), the lower edge is above the stage and no closed spot forms.
map.在固定光束角下，垂直光轴圆截面半径 ≈ 斜射距离 × tan(半角)；舞台水平投: For a fixed beam angle, the perpendicular cross-section radius ≈ slant distance × tan(half-angle); the stage-floor projection is additionally divided by sin(projection angle), so height, horizontal distance and projection angle together determine the ellipse axes and area. When the projection angle is not greater than the half-beam angle, no closed spot forms on the stage.
